title: BDS ISO 19650 container naming (V1.4, 11-field)
_note: Swappable reference ruleset for the BDS pilot — replace with the Base template when it exists. Form: Project-Originator-DocType-SubType-Discipline-Zone-Venue-Level-Number-Suit-Rev. Example: BDS20268-BDS-M3-IFC4-ARC-ZZ-XX-XX-M001-S2-P03

fields.label: Document Type
fields.description: M3=3D model, DR=drawing, SH=schedule, SP=spec, CR=clash, FED=federated, VS=visual

fields.label: Sub-Type
fields.description: e.g. IFC4, FP, RM, HV, EQ — NA when not applicable

fields.label: Zone
fields.description: Z01… per zone, ZZ = whole building

fields.label: Venue
fields.description: Venue code (e.g. VNU), XX = not applicable

fields.label: Revision
fields.description: P01… pre-contract, C01… construction; minor P01.01
